meta.title: Vink: AI document data extraction for operations teams
meta.description: Stop retyping PDFs. Vink reads invoices, claim forms and work orders, even handwritten ones, and puts the data in your system. 20 free pages.

og.title: Paper. Vink. Done.
og.alt: Vink. Paper. Vink. Done. No more retyping paperwork.

hero.title: Nobody has to retype PDFs anymore.
hero.subtitle: Vink reads invoices, claim forms and work orders, even handwritten ones, and puts the data in your system. Your team only checks what Vink isn't sure about.
hero.screenLabel: The Vink review screen with one value that needs review

video.title: A handwritten work order, without retyping.
video.subtitle: From paper to back office.
video.label: A 30-second film of a handwritten work order going through Vink

forms.title: You make the Form. Vink fills it in.
forms.subtitle: A Form is your list of fields. Vink matches every PDF, email or photo to those fields, and sends the data to your own application.

form.title: You make a Form.
form.body: Pick the fields you need: text, number, date, or a list of lines. Or upload one sample PDF, and Vink proposes the fields.

match.title: Vink matches every invoice.
match.body: Every supplier uses a different layout. Vink still finds your fields, also on a scan or in handwriting. You build no template per supplier.

send.title: Your application gets the data.
send.body: After approval, the data goes to your own system as JSON. Your field names are the keys.

forms.sameKeys: Pick another invoice. The values change, the keys stay the same.

kinds.title: One Form per kind of document.
kinds.body: Make as many Forms as you need. Each Form has its own fields, its own email address and its own integrations.

calculator.title: What retyping costs you now.
calculator.subtitle: Fill in your own numbers. You see what retyping costs per month, and what Vink costs.
calculator.note: Based on {days} working days a month and 1 page per PDF. Your team still spends some time on the values Vink flags.

journey.title: From PDF to your system.
journey.subtitle: Vink does the retyping. Your team only does the checking.

arrives.title: Email the PDF, or drop it in.
arrives.body: It works with any kind of document, even scanned or filled in by hand. You don't build templates.
arrives.intake: Drop several PDFs at once, or give a Form its own email address. Suppliers and colleagues then email their PDFs straight to Vink. PDF attachments, up to 10 MB and 20 pages each.

reads.title: Vink fills in your fields.
reads.body: For most invoices, the invoice number, amounts and lines are ready within a minute. Each value shows the page Vink found it on.

check.title: Your team only checks the doubtful values.
check.body: Vink flags every value it isn't sure about. You confirm it, or you type the right value. Nothing is sent without your approval.

lands.title: The data is in your system.
lands.body: After approval, the data goes to your accounting, ERP or database. Turn on Auto-Send, and Vink sends it by itself when there is nothing to check.

connect.title: Vink connects to any system.
connect.subtitle: Your developer connects one webhook, or we build the connection for you.

dev.title: One signed webhook.
dev.body: JSON keyed by your own Fields, an HMAC signature, retries and a test-send.

service.title: We connect it for you.
service.body: Tell us which system your data needs to reach. We build and test the connection, for a fixed price agreed up front.
service.point1: Your ERP, accounting package, spreadsheet or database
service.point3: One price, agreed before we start

standard.title: Or start with a standard integration.
standard.body: For these services, the integration is ready to use. They are only a start: through the Webhook, Vink works with any system.
standard.link: See how to set them up

pricing.title: Every plan includes everything.
pricing.subtitle: You only choose how many pages. Prices excl. VAT.
pricing.free: Start with 20 free pages. No credit card.

wrong.q: What if Vink reads something wrong?
wrong.a: You see every value Vink isn't sure about, with what it read and on which page. Nothing is sent until someone approves it.

messy.q: Our paperwork is messy, or handwritten.
messy.a: Try it on your own papers. The first 20 pages are free, no credit card needed.

developer.a: We'll build the connection to your system for you. It's a paid service with a price agreed up front.

templates.q: Do I need to set up templates?
templates.a: No. Describe your fields, or let Vink propose them from one example. After that, Vink matches every new PDF, email or photo to your fields by itself, whatever the layout. It reads PDFs of up to 10 MB and 20 pages.
